messages.subject_clean: Issue 33 in renjin: Integrate renjin with an existing Spring MVC web app running on Tomcat 7 on Windows XP SP3
messages.body_plain:
Hi Timothy,

(Moving from Issue Tracker to discussion group)

The Read-Eval-Print-Loop (REPL) is really for consoles and interactive evaluation of R expressions, but Renjin has other APIs for embedding.

To embed in a webapp, you'll want to use the javax.script interface. I'm afraid the documentation is still sparse (Renjin the Book coming soon!) but you can find a few lines of example code here:

http://code.google.com/p/renjin/wiki/CallingRFromJava

If you're just looking to execute predefined R scripts or functions on behalf of he user, you'll find the javax.script interface straightforward. If you want the user to be able to execute R code interactively, that works too-- but it can be more complicated if you want state to be shared between executions. That is if you want something like:

Request #1:
x <- 1

Request #2
y <- x *2

Then you'll need to a keep a script ScriptEngine instance per user in memory in your webapp. This is possible, but obviously gets complicated when you try to scale. The other approach is to serialize the state of the ScriptEngine between requests -- see the appengine-sample for example -- but this isn't perfect because there are somethings that are hard to serialize like open files or the search path of loaded packages.

If you need any more information or pointers, just ask -- and I promise that better documentation is on the way!

Best,
Alex

New issue 33 by timothy....@hazelband.com: Integrate renjin with an existing Spring MVC web app running on Tomcat 7 on Windows XP SP3
http://code.google.com/p/renjin/issues/detail?id=33

I was wondering if it is possible to embed renjin into an existing web app? the web app is a hospital management system and is running on tomcat server using MySQL database. I want to have a link that allows the administrator to click on it and it loads renjin cli window to allow statistical evaluation of datasets provided for by the web app. I have already incoporated renjin into the the web app and added the dependencies into the pom.xml. To initialize it, I call it from a jsp file using this command

->JlineRepl.main(new String[0]);<-

but I get this error:

->org.renjin.parser.RLexException: IOException while reading<-

Please advice how to proceed. Assume I am a newbie.
